name: Robert Guy
source:
He is the competent butler of the theater and the heroine's superior, and although he sometimes treats the manager harshly, he serves faithfully.
He is uncompromising when it comes to his work and is always perfect so no one can complain.
His abilities are high, but there are many unknown points in his career, and his origins are shrouded in mystery.

[Translated from the [url=https://twitter.com/CFGame_veribaro/status/1553681879248687105]official twitter[/url]]
